content:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: smart-routing observed repetitive region fallbacks for EU requests -> surge of 5xxs and token latency. Affected route: /v1/generate, model family: redwood-open-13b. Hypothesis: fallback to quantized variant (q4_0) which does not support tool-calling and shorter context leading to rejects and a routing oscillation.

Mia (oncall): acked. I'm on it — switching to incident channel. Please post findings here. :pager:

Sam (eng-runtime): looking at smart-routing logs now. I see a tight loop: policy tries eu-llm-fp16 -> capacity full -> fallback to eu-llm-q4 -> requests fail with "unsupported_feature: tool_calling" -> policy interprets as model failure and routes back to region or other variants, causing oscillation.

Devin (eng-sre): confirmed in infra metrics: EU GPU pool hit 95% GPU mem for redwood-open-13b fp16 around 21:07 UTC and policy staged fallback at 21:08. Error spike aligns.

Jordan (devex): Anya, any cherrypicked customer reports?

Anya (support): AcmeCorp (customers/acme) reported increased error rate at ~21:09 UTC. They rely heavily on tool-calls in prompts. CS already opened a case.

Mia (oncall): Immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) disable smart-routing fallback to quantized variant for this model family in EU 2) pin route for active customers to fp16 variant 3) temporarily increase capacity threshold (suppress fallback) while we stabilize. Which is fastest?

Sam (eng-runtime): Fastest = flip routing policy flag to disallow q-variants as fallback for toolcall-enabled routes. I'll run the policy patch.

Sam (eng-runtime): running command to apply temporary policy change:

```
redwoodctl routing update --policy smart-routing-eu \
  --matcher 'route:/v1/generate, feature:tool_calling' \
  --disallow-variants 'q4_0,q4_1' 
```

Sam (eng-runtime): applied. Confirming policy rollout to edge proxies...

ops-bot: policy-update: smart-routing-eu modified by Sam. rollout status: 4/4 proxies updated.

Devin (eng-sre): also bumped the pool threshold to avoid aggressive fallback:

```
redwoodctl infra patch pool eu-gpu-pool --fallback-threshold 0.98
```

Devin (eng-sre): pool threshold updated, autoscaler paused for 2m while changes reconcile.

Mia (oncall): Observability — show error rate/latency now.

Sam (eng-runtime): Metrics: 21:12 UTC -> 21:20 UTC error rate for /v1/generate from EU dropped from 18% -> 3%. P95 latency back to baseline. No new "unsupported_feature" logs after policy change.

Anya (support): Confirmed AcmeCorp error rate is down and calls restored. They'll keep monitoring on their side. CS posted a note to the account.

Jordan (devex): Good triage. Next steps: 1) reproduce the compat matrix bug in staging (q4 variants flagged as not supporting tool_calling but our metadata allowed them) 2) add a safety check to routing eval so variants missing tool_calling are never selected for routes that request it 3) postmortem and customer RCA.

Sam (eng-runtime): I dug into model metadata service — the compat table had an entry for redwood-open-13b:q4_0 with tool_calling: true due to a bad ingest job on 2026-02-14. Changing to false now.

Sam (eng-runtime): fix applied to model-metadata service. Patch:

```
PATCH /metadata/models/redwood-open-13b/variants/q4_0
Body: { "capabilities": { "tool_calling": false } }
```

ops-bot: model-metadata updated by Sam. deploy-id=mm-2026-02-15-1147.

Devin (eng-sre): Will schedule a forced reconcile of routing decisions to pick up metadata change. Running reconciliation script.

Devin (eng-sre): reconcile kicked off: job id recon-214159-01.

Mia (oncall): Communications: Jordan/Anya, please send short customer and internal blurb: what happened, immediate mitigation, and whether any data was impacted.

Anya (support): Drafting customer note for impacted accounts. No data exfiltration or content modification — purely availability errors.

Jordan (devex): Internal blurb in #status-updates once we have postmortem owner. I'll own postmortem. Tentative sev: sev2 -> moving to sev3 after mitigation confirmed.

Mia (oncall): Assigning follow-ups:
- Postmortem owner: Jordan (devex)
- Fix compat-matrix ingest: Sam (eng-runtime)
- Routing safety gate: Sam + Devin
- Customer comms: Anya (support)

Mia (oncall): Anything else? Otherwise I will close the pager and hand back to regular oncall in 15m.

Sam (eng-runtime): I'll add a unit/regression test to metadata ingestion verifying capability flags for tool_calling and context_window.

Devin (eng-sre): We'll add an alert if a variant is selected and returns "unsupported_feature" more than 5 times in a minute — to avoid oscillation loops.

Anya (support): Customers notified. No further reports at this time.

Mia (oncall): Closing pager at 21:26 UTC. Postmortem ETA 48 hours. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
